# Vendored, do not edit

Copied verbatim from <https://github.com/angular/skills> (`angular-developer/`), commit `f5a78e5`, on
2026-09-13. Prettier is told to leave this folder alone so the files stay byte-identical to upstream.

To update: delete this folder's `SKILL.md` and `references/`, copy the current upstream
`angular-developer/` in their place, and set the commit and date above. Nothing in this repository
depends on a local change here; anything specific to this application belongs in `docs/`, which wins
over the skill where the two meet (see `AGENTS.md`).
